correctness.rationale: For all positive side lengths, the planar zonotope identities are exact. The common-index Haar beta-marginal integral is 1/4 and the complementary-index Hodge product integral is pi/16; the latter uses the invariant probability on Gr+(2,4) identified with the product of two uniform 2-spheres. Expansion yields the exact mixed moment. The mean values e2/3 and 4e1/3 and a checked positive sum-of-squares identity yield the sharp covariance bound, with equality precisely when all sides agree. A separate Gaussian Gram–Schmidt sampler reproduced both critical integrals and three mixed moments (180000 trials); finite sampling is supplementary.

value.rationale: An explicitly numerical 4-cube joint moment in Finch 2012 receives an exact short analytic evaluation. Extending to all four-dimensional orthotopes identifies two universal incidence probabilities, proves unavoidable positive area–perimeter covariance, and gives the exact optimal normalized coefficient with only cubes as equality cases. These are natural sharp geometric invariants and a sign theorem, not routine numerical refinements or unmotivated slices.
